description: This PHP class 'ImpactDataItem' models a data entity associated with impact data and impact items within the Goteo project. It provides methods for retrieving, saving, validating, and deleting impact data items, and interacts with the database table 'impact_data_item'.

classes.name: ImpactDataItem
classes.description: A model class representing an impact data item, linking impact data and impact items with database persistence.

methods.name: setImpactData
methods.description: Sets the associated ImpactData object and returns the instance for chaining.

methods.name: setImpactItem
methods.description: Sets the associated ImpactItem object and returns the instance for chaining.

methods.name: getListByImpactData
methods.description: Fetches a list of ImpactDataItem instances related to a specific ImpactData.

methods.name: getByImpactItem
methods.description: Retrieves a single ImpactDataItem associated with a given ImpactItem.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the ImpactDataItem to the database, inserting or replacing as necessary.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that ImpactDataItem has both impactData and impactItem set.

methods.name: dbDelete
methods.description: Deletes impact data items matching specified criteria from the database.
